meta.title: Sitting Lok Sabha MPs by Declared Criminal Cases
meta.source_label: MyNeta.info / Association for Democratic Reforms (ADR), based on ECI election affidavits
meta.methodology_note: Case counts are self-declared by candidates in their sworn Form 26 affidavits filed with the Election Commission of India ahead of the 2024 general election. MyNeta/ADR digitizes these public filings. A case count reflects cases filed against the MP, not convictions. Under Indian law, an accused is presumed innocent until proven guilty. This covers 484 of 543 winning candidates: the remainder did not have a digitized criminal-case entry in the source list at the time of collection. Each row links to its own source affidavit page.
